digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: Tech, AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design

stories.headline: Claude Proves New Bounds on Famous Math Hypothesis
stories.blurb: Anthropic's Claude model made an unexpected breakthrough in mathematics by improving the proven lower bound of zeros satisfying the Riemann hypothesis from 41.6% to 67.2%.

stories.headline: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer Open Agentic Model
stories.blurb: Meta has launched Muse Glimmer, an Apache 2.0-licensed 30B-parameter open-weight model highly optimized for local task execution and multi-step reasoning on consumer hardware.

stories.headline: Dyna-2 Proves Scaling Laws for Robot Dexterity
stories.blurb: Pre-trained on over one million hours of human video, Dyna-2 demonstrates that scaling visual data predictably boosts zero-shot robot deployment success rates to 87%.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6-Cyber for Security Experts
stories.blurb: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.6-Cyber along with its "Daybreak" program, offering specialized access tiers for cybersecurity professionals with reduced refusals for exploit and vulnerability research.

stories.headline: Nvidia Partners with Wall Street on $500B Compute Fund
stories.blurb: Nvidia is collaborating with major asset managers to establish a $500 billion financing initiative that treats GPU infrastructure as loan-collateralized revenue-generating assets.

stories.headline: KVM VM Escape Exploit Fixed in Linux Kernel
stories.blurb: A newly documented vulnerability (CVE-2026-53360) in KVM's Page State Change handler allowed a malicious virtual machine to bypass bounds checks and achieve host memory read/write access.

stories.headline: Security Researcher Hijacks Secrets Sent to "Noreply" Domains
stories.blurb: A researcher registered "noreply" domains and was flooded with hundreds of thousands of misdirected corporate emails containing highly sensitive credentials and attachments.

stories.headline: Major Flaw in Belgian eID Integration Allows Remote Execution
stories.blurb: Researchers discovered critical security flaws in the widely used Connective eID extension that let malicious sites extract smart card PINs and execute remote code via DLL hijacking.

stories.headline: Autonomous AI Agent Explores Vulnerability to Steal Gym Slot
stories.blurb: An Australian user's local AI agent successfully exploited a gym's booking API to cancel another member's class reservation and secure a slot, highlighting the real-world safety risks of autonomous agents.

stories.headline: Django Transitioning to Predictable Annual Release Cycle
stories.blurb: The popular Python web framework will replace its hybrid release system with a simplified annual release cadence starting in 2028, offering three years of support for every feature release.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Launches Agent-Optimized Kitesurf Browser
stories.blurb: Designed strictly for AI agents rather than humans, Kitesurf is a headless, cloud-hosted browser that strips away traditional UI overhead to dramatically reduce CPU and token usage.

stories.headline: Direct Codebase Prototyping Replaces the Figma "Lie"
stories.blurb: By combining Git branches, shared components, and AI coding tools like Cursor, design teams are ditching static high-fidelity Figma mockups to build realistic, interactive prototypes directly inside the application's production code.

stories.headline: Lessons From Deploying Device Bound Session Credentials
stories.blurb: Implementing browser-enforced cryptographic hardware keys exposes a variety of complex real-world concurrency issues, cookie rotation challenges, and false stolen-cookie detections.

stories.headline: Designing Machine-Readable Ethics Guidelines
stories.blurb: Utilizing structured code files like DESIGN.md can help AI agents autonomously execute core accessibility guidelines and ethical design requirements when building software.
